items.exampleEn: The little girl sobbed when she lost her balloon.
items.exampleZh: 那個小女孩弄丟氣球時哭得抽抽噎噎的。

items.exampleEn: It was an ignorant comment that upset many people.
items.exampleZh: 那是一句無知的話，讓很多人不高興。

items.exampleEn: There has been a worrying rise in food prices.
items.exampleZh: 食物價格的上漲令人擔心。

items.exampleEn: Big fish sometimes bully smaller fish in the tank.
items.exampleZh: 魚缸裡的大魚有時會欺負小魚。

items.exampleEn: She dresses in a youthful style.
She eagerly accepted the invitation to the party.
items.exampleZh: 她迫不及待地接受了派對的邀請。

items.exampleEn: There was desperation in his voice when he asked for more time.
items.exampleZh: 他要求多一點時間時，聲音裡透著絕望。

items.exampleEn: Watching our team lose in the last second was agony.
items.exampleZh: 看著我們隊在最後一秒輸掉，真是煎熬。

items.sentenceEn: She knocked on every door in the street in desperation, looking for her cat.
items.sentenceZh: 她急得挨家挨戶敲門，想找到她的貓。

items.audioEn: The children waited eagerly at the window for their father to come home.
items.audioZh: 孩子們在窗邊迫不及待地等爸爸回家。
options: Watching the rain fall outside the window
Looking forward to seeing their dad

items.sentenceEn: The old theater got a youthful new look after the repairs.
items.sentenceZh: 那間老戲院整修後，有了充滿朝氣的新面貌。

items.sentenceEn: I heard someone sobbing quietly in the next room.
items.sentenceZh: 我聽到隔壁房間有人在小聲啜泣。

items.stemEn: The low water level in the river is ____ for farmers this year.
items.stemZh: 今年河川水位很低，讓農夫很擔心。

items.stemEn: The last kilometer of the race was pure ____ for my tired legs.
items.stemZh: 比賽最後一公里，對我疲憊的雙腿來說完全是折磨。

items.passageEn: Last year, a survey at our school showed a worrying result: one in five students said that someone had tried to bully them. Many teachers admitted that they had been ignorant of the problem. So the school started a "buddy" program, in which older students look after new ones. It is run by our art teacher, who is over sixty but still has a youthful energy. My buddy, a cheerful senior with a big smile, eagerly showed me around on my first day and sat with me at lunch. The goal of no bullying at all may not be fully achievable, but students say that the school feels much friendlier now.
items.passageZh: 去年，我們學校的一項調查顯示了令人擔心的結果：每五個學生就有一個說曾有人想欺負他們。很多老師承認，他們之前並不知道有這個問題。於是學校開始了「學伴」計畫，由高年級生照顧新生。負責的是我們的美術老師，她六十多歲了，卻還是充滿朝氣。我的學伴是一位開朗、笑容燦爛的高年級生，第一天就熱心地帶我參觀學校，午餐時也陪我坐。完全沒有霸凌的目標也許無法百分之百達成，但學生們說，現在學校的氣氛友善多了。

questions.questionZh: 學校為什麼開始「學伴」計畫？
options: 老師們想讓高年級生多做點事情
新生人數比去年多了一倍以上
調查發現霸凌問題令人擔心

questions.questionZh: 作者上學第一天怎麼樣？
options: 一個人在大校園裡迷路了

items.promptZh: 我對車子的事一無所知。
referenceEn: I am completely ignorant about cars.
I'm totally ignorant when it comes to cars.
rubricZh: ignorant 的用法，例如 ignorant about、ignorant of、ignorant when it comes to 等
時態合理（例如 am 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 agony 造一個句子，說說一段讓你覺得很煎熬的經驗。
referenceEn: Waiting at the airport during a twelve-hour delay was agony.
Sitting through the boring three-hour meeting was agony for me.
rubricZh: agony 的用法，例如 was agony、was agony for me 等
時態合理（例如 was 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：疑似：用 youthful-looking 形容高年級學生不自然（學生本來就年輕，youthful 多用於形容年紀較大者顯年輕），中譯「看起來很年輕」也因此怪；建議改成形容其他特質，或把 youthful 用在老師等成人身上。
